narr: Scattered thunderstorms developed in northwest Illinois, impacting a few counties in the warning area in the afternoon and early evening hours. Severe thunderstorms produced large hail and flash flooding in Bureau and Putnam Counties. Even impacts due to a lightning strike were noted.
ev: Urban flash flooding of streets occurred in Spring Valley. Route 6 near Spring Valley curve was completely flooded.
lsr: CORRECTS PREVIOUS FLASH FLOOD REPORT FROM 1 E SPRING VALLEY. URBAN FLOODING OF STREETS OCCURRING IN SPRING VALLEY. ROUTE 6 NEAR SPRING VALLEY CURVE IS COMPLETELY FLOODED.
